options.name: path
options.description: Path to be used for changing owner.

options.name: recurse
options.description: Indicates if the owner should be changed recursively.

options.name: user
options.description: Name to be used for changing owner. This value can be in the form of a SecurityIdentifier string, a user or group in the Netlogon C(DOMAIN\User) or UPN format (user@DOMAIN.COM).
